[mono][color=#897236]DESIGNATION[/color] SPC-RMN[/mono]
[mono][color=#897236]CLASS [/color] Humanoid // Ruminant[/mono]
[mono][color=#897236]ORIGIN [/color] Runia[/mono]
[mono][color=#897236]METABOLIC [/color] [color=#a4885c][bold]Iron BLood[/bold][/color] — Standard Baseline[/mono]
[mono][color=#897236]STATUS [/color] [color=lime]► Approved, Conditional[/color][/mono]
Subject: A hooved, unguligrade species of Ruminants from the pastoral planet Runia in the Lanei system. Peaceful by nature, their society was archaic before first contact and has forced them to adapt to modern society. Their fine wool grows at an alarming rate, requiring frequent maintenance to not become a hazard. This coat of wool is of great cultural importance, gifts of wool being a sign of great trust and friendship. Shearing of an Ovinia qualifies as assault.
[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=#ff66aa][bold]TOLERANCE PROFILE[/bold][/color] ───────────────────────────────[/mono][/color]
[mono] Heat [color=#1e90ff]■■■■[/color][color=#555555]□[/color] resistant – wool provides partial insulation against high temperatures[/mono]
[mono] Cold [color=#1e90ff]■■■■[/color][color=#555555]□[/color] resistant – wool provides partial insulation against rapid freezing vulnerable[/mono]
[mono] Pressure [color=#897236]■■■[/color][color=#555555]□□[/color] baseline[/mono]
[mono] Shock [color=#1e90ff]■■■■[/color][color=#555555]□[/color] resistant – wool provides partial insulation from electrical shocks[/mono]
[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=#ffa500][bold]DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS[/bold][/color] ──────────────────────────[/mono][/color]
- [color=#ffa500][bold]Dietary range[/bold][/color]: Herbivore. Ensure adequate vegetables and grains are made available to Ovinians in sector. - [color=red][bold]▲ Warning:[/bold][/color] [color=#a4885c][bold]Theobromine[/bold][/color] (chocolate, tea, coffee) and [color=#a4885c][bold]Allicin[/bold][/color] (onion, garlic) are toxic. Both induce poison damage in the bloodstream.
[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=#00ccff][bold]RESPIRATORY PROTOCOL[/bold][/color] ────────────────────────────[/mono][/color]
- Breathes [color=#1e90ff][bold]Oxygen[/bold][/color]; suffocates without sufficient supply. - Inert [color=#1e90ff][bold]Nitrogen[/bold][/color] tolerated as atmospheric buffer. - Pressure tolerance: safe [color=#1e90ff][bold]50–385 kPa[/bold][/color]; barotrauma outside [color=#ffa500][bold]20–550 kPa[/bold][/color].
[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=#1e90ff][bold]WORKPLACE APTITUDES[/bold][/color] ─────────────────────────────[/mono][/color]
- [color=#1e90ff][bold]Peaceful Nature[/bold][/color] causes certain xenofauna to not be hostile towards Ovinia. - [color=#1e90ff][bold]Thick wool coats[/bold][/color] provides partial insulation against heat, cold, and electrical shocks. Engineering assignments are preferable due to these genetic capabilities. - [color=#1e90ff][bold]Vulnerable hide[/bold][/color] is susceptible to both slashing and piercing. - Take [color=#1e90ff][bold]increased toxins and radiation damage[/bold][/color]. - [color=#1e90ff][bold]Reinforced hooves[/bold][/color] prevent cuts from walking on substances such as glass.
[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=#ffdd33][bold]SPECIAL PROTOCOLS[/bold][/color] ───────────────────────────────[/mono][/color]
- [color=#a4885c][bold]No entries on file[/bold][/color]
[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=#cc3333][bold]LIABILITIES / INSURANCE FLAGS[/bold][/color] ───────────────────[/mono][/color]
[color=red][bold]▲ Warning:[/bold][/color] [color=#ffa500][bold]Due to excessive systemic shock from radiation and toxins, an ample supply of appropriate medications is to be kept on hand for treatments when possible.
